blocks.title: Impact
blocks.text:
Since 2001, Processing has grown from a tool for artists and designers into a global movement shaping how people learn, teach, and create with code across every continent. 

By maintaining creative coding software as a commons, resourcing the people who maintain it, and building pathways for those who learn with our tools, Processing Foundation expands who gets to shape technology and culture.

blocks.subtitle: Processing Foundation
blocks.body:
The 2025 Impact Report marks a pivotal year of evolution for Processing Foundation, highlighting strategic program growth and deepening community engagement. 

Learn more about the software releases, educational initiatives, and work being done to build a more equitable and accessible creative coding ecosystem.
